subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` header make `/v1/chat/completions` ignore arbitrary OpenAI SDK `model` values and use the selected agent's configured model?
rationale: Current source, tests, and docs intentionally treat request-body `model` as an OpenClaw agent target, so accepting generic SDK model values changes a public Gateway API precedence rule.

options.title: Approve header precedence
options.body: Allow generic request-body model values to be ignored only after `x-openclaw-agent-id` resolves to a known agent, with docs and regression tests covering the exception.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Continue requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>` and direct callers to `x-openclaw-model` for backend model overrides.

recommendation.title: Approve header precedence
recommendation.body: Allow generic request-body model values to be ignored only after `x-openclaw-agent-id` resolves to a known agent, with docs and regression tests covering the exception.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current agent-first Gateway contract this issue would relax or reaffirm.
